Men’s Gold Medal Hockey Team!

[Image] The image shows Donald Trump seated at the Resolute Desk in the Oval Office, surrounded by a group of athletes wearing matching navy sweaters with "USA" emblazoned on them. Many of the athletes are holding Olympic medals, and one is displaying a signed jersey. The room features American flags and a portrait of Ronald Reagan on the wall. The atmosphere is celebratory, highlighting the athletes' achievements.
